ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Mavinject.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed version of the "Mavinject" process. Which can be abused to perform process injection using the "/INJECTRUNNING" flag

sequences.query: (process_original_file_name = "mavinject32\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "mavinject64\.exe") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mavinject32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mavinject64\\\.exe$")))
